answer: Require each reward-eligible agent to lock 100 credits for 30 days before earning, with one earning slot per deposit and no early withdrawal. Agents named violet, comet and ripple would need three separate deposits; renaming or copying a key creates no extra slot. An attacker running 1,000 identities must immobilize 100,000 credits for a month, paying financing costs. This deters cheap identity farms, though wealthy attackers remain possible.
